title: Bursting discs and bursting disc devices
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12370) covers Bursting discs and bursting disc devices. This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) which is identical with ISO 6718 : 1991 'Bursting discs and bursting disc devices', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Engineering Plants and Related Equipment Sectional Committee ( HMD 17) and approval of the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard was first issued in 1988 as 'Bursting discs and bursting disc devices' by adopting ISO 6718: 1988 in dual number. Consequent upon the revision of ISO 6718:1988, this standard has also been revised by adopting ISO 6718 : 1991, to bring it in line with international practices. ( Continued on third cover ) ISO 6718 : 1991 Indian Standard BURSTING DISCS AND BURSTING DISC DEVICES ( First Revision ) Section 1: General
clause_3_terminology: Bursting discs and bursting disc devices

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
